summary: LANE 3 chokepoint parity map (worktree C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/smartcompare-kpi @ 7af40eb). Two weak chokepoints confirmed: (A) cache-READ `_cache_price_identity_ok` (structured_comparison_service.py:720-756, called at scs:4664 L1-Redis + scs:4676 L2-DB) and (B) display `is_price_showable(enforce_correctness=True)` (price_service.py:1313-1427, enforce sites response_builder.py:1240, scs:3450 SSE, scs:7029 /prices, text_routes.py:676 /price-kpi, zyte_service.py:672 seed). Both run only the axis-only `_backstop_identity_ok` (price_service.py:5800-5813, = `_axis_mismatch(strict_extras=False)`) + the bounded `_category_type_added` (price_service.py:4254-4263, fragrances-flagship + supplements-type ONLY) — strictly weaker than the write/selection gates (`should_cache_price` price_service.py:6139 + `select_best`/`_selection_match`). Runtime re-verification (offline, real functions, gate ON): 5 residual classes LEAK through BOTH weak chokepoints (gender flanker Eros→Pour Femme; non-flagship flanker Sauvage→Elixir; one-sided SPF; AirPods Pro→Pro 2 bare-generation; makeup one-sided finish-add), of which only 2 (gender flanker + one-sided SPF) ALSO pass the write gate = the warmer-writable poison classes today; ZMA→Cal-Mag leak direction is now CLOSED by 6a. Controls confirmed caught (S24→FE, EDP→EDT, Sauvage→Parfum, Whey→Isolate). Load-bearing new finding: on THIS branch the L2-DB round-trip drops title AND in_stock (product_data_service.py:103/119-126, save_price:139-152 — PR#12's migration-033 title persistence is NOT here), so every DB-served price re-enters identity-less → both weak chokepoints are VACUOUS for the entire DB leg, and scs:4679 re-promotes such rows into Redis under only the weak check. Secondary parity gap: the GPT-verdict scrub (extraction_service.py:1782) calls is_price_showable WITHOUT enforce_correctness/category, so a display-pended not_exact/OOS price's amount still reaches the verdict prompt. VariantDescriptor replacement plan, fail-closed directions, flag strategy, latency budget, and the runbook risk-quantification line are in recommendations.

recommendations.title: VariantDescriptor slot-in points (the replacement plan, item 3)
recommendations.details: Build `app/services/variant_descriptor.py`: `extract_variant_descriptor(text, category, brand='') -> VariantDescriptor` (frozen dataclass) FORMALIZING the existing pure-regex extractors already in price_service (extract_concentration:3008, _quals_in/_CATEGORY_VARIANT_QUALIFIERS, size/storage/count/strength/weight-volume, _percents:4280, SPF, _supplement forms/types:4354+, flavour/finish/material/fit, gender tokens, plus NEW fields: bare-generation int (electronics line), flanker-word from a curated table (elixir/supreme/absolu/intense/extreme — NEVER base-name words private/oud/noir/nuit), constituent-set (ZMA<->zinc-magnesium-aspartate expansion table), typed size {value, unit_class}). `descriptors_compatible(q, c, category) -> (bool, failing_field)` encodes per-field ASYMMETRY explicitly (one-sided tolerate vs fail-closed per field+category), replacing the blanket both-stated rule. Slot-ins: (1) display — replace price_service.py:1421-1424's `_backstop_identity_ok + _category_type_added` pair inside the enforce block; stamp guard_rejected='not_exact:<field>' for measurable blast radius (response_builder:1251-1255 diag already carries it); (2) cache-read — replace scs.py:753-756 with the SAME call so read==display parity is structural (one shared helper, not two parallel pairs); (3) verdict scrub — extraction_service.py:1782 gains category+enforce (F8); (4) OPTIONAL third consumer: the strict_extras branch of _axis_mismatch can delegate field-by-field later, but do NOT touch _selection_match in Wave-2 (write gates are airtight; churn there risks the KPI 18/18).

recommendations.title: Fail-closed directions + user-facing consequences (item 3)
recommendations.details: Cache-READ rejection = treated as MISS -> L1 reject falls to L2, L2 reject falls to the live cascade (scs:4664-4682). User consequence: correct-or-pending price after a slower resolve; on the 30s-capped cold path this can mean converted/pend. Cost consequence: re-resolution burns scrape/Serper budget — descriptor OVER-rejection at the read chokepoint structurally DEFEATS the warmer (every warmed entry re-resolves), which is exactly why the full superset was reverted there; the descriptor must be calibrated leak-closing WITHOUT widening rejection of descriptive PDP titles ('Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%', 'Tom Ford Private Blend Oud Wood'). Display rejection = make_pending_price -> FE 'Pricing lands in a future update' line, scoring takes the missing-data path, reason recorded in metadata (never on the public price; public_price_view strips guard_rejected + _-keys, price_service.py:6205-6221). Over-rejection at display = coverage loss only, never incorrectness — so when in doubt, bias display fail-closed and cache-read tolerate.

recommendations.title: Flag-OFF byte-identity strategy (item 3)
recommendations.details: New flag ENABLE_VARIANT_DESCRIPTOR, nested UNDER exact_gate_enabled() (both must be on), default OFF at land -> flip after the both-directions coverage sweep + comm gate, mirroring the ENABLE_EXACT_PRICE_GATE discipline. Flag-OFF path must execute the EXACT current pair (_backstop_identity_ok + _category_type_added) at both chokepoints — pin with a golden byte-identity test like PR#9's. Keep the existing pinned xfails in tests/test_correctness_coverage_sweep_fixes.py as the flip ledger: each residual the descriptor closes flips xfail->pass (design doc §5).

recommendations.title: Latency budget (item 3)
recommendations.details: Live-path descriptor build+compare must be pure regex + frozenset/table lookup — NO LLM, NO I/O. Inputs are already capped at _MATCH_INPUT_CAP=512 chars (price_service.py:5310-5313) -> O(microseconds-to-low-ms) per price; called ~2-6x per compare at the chokepoints. Compute ONCE per price and stamp `price['_variant_desc']` at resolution — Redis serializes it free, public_price_view auto-strips it (underscore prefix), the chokepoints reuse instead of re-extracting; only the QUERY-side descriptor is recomputed per request. Option C's 'narrow LLM hint' runs OFF-CLOCK ONLY (warmer/seed enrichment persisting a hint field into the cached object); the live path reads the persisted hint or decides on regex fields alone. Verify with DEBUG_STAGE_TIMINGS before/after.

recommendations.title: WARMER runbook justification line (item 4 quantification)
recommendations.details: If ENABLE_PRICE_CACHE_WARMER were flipped TODAY (KPI 18/18, write gates airtight) the residual poisoning surface by code-reading is: (1) TWO warmer-WRITABLE wrong-SKU classes pass should_cache_price and then display for the 7d genuine TTL — gender flanker (Eros->Eros Pour Femme; runtime-verified selection=True AND should_cache=True) and one-sided SPF (CeraVe->+SPF 30; same) — with exposure WIDENED by ENABLE_ADAPTER_QUERY_LADDER=ON (core-term retrieval surfaces flanker-only inventory, plan §F1); (2) the L2-DB leg is identity-BLIND on this branch (no title/in_stock round-trip, F6) — any historic wrong DB row within its freshness window serves unverified and gets re-promoted into Redis at scs:4679 past the weak gate; (3) purge-missed legacy Redis/DB entries of the latent classes (Elixir-flanker, bare-generation, finish-add) serve full-TTL through the weak read/display backstops (runtime-verified cache_read_ok=True + showable=True). Wave-2 descriptor + title/descriptor persistence (merge/extend PR#12 migration 033) + the fresh purge close (2)(3) and the gender/flanker fields close most of (1); one-sided SPF remains a documented pinned tradeoff unless the descriptor's inherent-SPF product-class exception decides it.

recommendations.title: Wave-2 hard dependency: identity persistence for the DB leg
recommendations.details: Before or with the descriptor: persist title (PR#12 migration 033 + ENABLE_PRICE_TITLE_PERSIST — currently on the warmer branch, NOT on feature/genuine-price-kpi) and preferably the serialized descriptor + in_stock on product_prices, and SELECT them back in get_cached_price (product_data_service.py:103). Without this, cache-read/display descriptor checks are vacuous for every DB-served price and the warmer's 7-day genuine TTL rides on an unverifiable leg. PR sequencing note: #12 -> #13 -> kpi branch merge order already planned; make migration 033 part of the Wave-2 preconditions checklist.

recommendations.title: Coverage-sweep verifier for Wave-2 (both directions)
recommendations.details: The descriptor's own over-rejection is the next blind spot. The sweep MUST include the known false-pend traps: femme-base fragrances (women's base lines where 'pour femme' IS the base — the current asymmetric tolerance at price_service.py gender helpers), inherent-SPF sunscreens (Anthelios SPF 50+ one-sided, pinned test_R6_overrej_skincare_spf_*), descriptive constituent-enumerating supplement titles (a correct 'NOW ZMA Zinc Magnesium Aspartate' PDP title must NOT be rejected by the constituent field — note 6a already rejects it today at the weak chokepoints per the _supplement_type_added token logic, an EXISTING over-rejection the descriptor's expansion table should FIX, not inherit), base-name flanker words ('Tom Ford Private Blend Oud Wood' IS 'Oud Wood'), and brand-omitted sephora-style titles. Reproduce through the runtime selectors (is_price_showable enforce=True, _cache_price_identity_ok, should_cache_price) exactly as this lane's harness does (scratchpad lane3_chokepoint_verify.py is reusable).
